pasos: Open Sales and pick the vehicle you are interested in.
When the sale opens, the request button gives you a queue number. The server assigns it when it receives your request, not your device clock, and you cannot request before the sale opens.
The lowest number wins the vehicle, except in sales that are awarded manually. If the person ahead of you does not pay in time, the award moves to the next one.
A sale may limit how many vehicles one person can be awarded.

pagar.titulo: How to pay for what you were awarded
pasos: Payment is not collected in this application: you pay through the process the sale specifies.
Once you have the receipt, upload it from My requests before the deadline passes.
Treasury reviews it and either approves it or rejects it with a reason. If the deadline passes, the vehicle moves to the next person in the queue.
Enter the details and upload the photographs from Vehicles.
An available vehicle can be edited or withdrawn; a reserved or sold one cannot.
Only available vehicles can be included in a sale.
Create the sale as a draft and include the vehicles that will go on sale.
Check the dates: publication cannot be later than the sale start, and the end comes after the start.
Send it for approval. Whoever decides on it cannot be the person who created it.
Once approved, publish it. From then on participants can see it, and the sale opens on the start date.

dictaminar.titulo: How to decide on a sale
pasos: Approvals holds the ones awaiting a decision, longest waiting first.
Open the detail to review the vehicles and the dates before deciding.
You cannot approve a sale you created yourself. Rejecting it requires a reason, and it goes on the audit log.
Only sales marked as manually awarded reach this queue.
Open the lot to see the queue with the identity of everyone in it and each number.
When you award, a reason is required and is recorded alongside your decision.
Treasury holds the requests with a receipt uploaded, oldest first.
Download the receipt and check it against the payment, which happens outside this application.
Approve the payment to close the sale, or reject it with a reason: the vehicle goes back to the queue.
The audit log records every state change with who did it and when. It cannot be modified or deleted.
You can rebuild the historical queue of a lot and see who held each number.
The export delivers the filtered events so you can review them outside the application.

convocatorias.descripcion: Groups of vehicles offered for sale.
convocatorias.sinResultados: There are no sale announcements with this status.
convocatorias.soloLectura: This sale announcement can no longer be edited in its current status.
convocatorias.folioAyuda: Stored in uppercase and cannot be repeated.
convocatorias.nombreAyuda: How it is recognized in lists and in the audit log. It may be repeated.
convocatorias.horasLiquidacionAyuda: Calendar hours from the award, not business days.
convocatorias.campoLimiteAdjudicaciones: Vehicles a participant may be awarded
convocatorias.limiteAdjudicacionesAyuda: Maximum per participant in this call for bids. It is released if the deadline passes or treasury rejects the payment; a completed purchase consumes it permanently.
convocatorias.limiteSolicitudesAyuda: Maximum per participant in this call for bids. It counts attempts: canceled, expired and rejected requests still count. Those beyond the limit are recorded and canceled right away.
convocatorias.sinLotes: No vehicles have been included yet.
convocatorias.sinDisponibles: There are no available vehicles to include.
convocatorias.incluido: Vehicle included in the sale announcement.
convocatorias.loteRetirado: Lot removed. The vehicle returns to the catalog.
convocatorias.motivoRetiroLoteAyuda: It is recorded in the audit log. It is required.
convocatorias.retiroLoteAviso: The lot leaves the sale announcement and is no longer published. The vehicle returns to the catalog and can be included in another sale announcement.
convocatorias.loteConFila: It cannot be removed: participants are already queued.
convocatorias.enOtraConvocatoria: That vehicle joined another active sale announcement. Refresh the list and choose a different one.
convocatorias.vistaPreviaVisible: This is how participants with access to this sale type see this announcement.
convocatorias.vistaPreviaAunNoVisible: It is not visible to anyone yet. This is how it will look once published:
convocatorias.vistaPreviaEnlaces: Vehicles open inside this same preview. The participant actions are shown, but disabled.

validacionConvocatoria.caracter_no_permitido: Only letters, digits and the signs - _ / are allowed

acciones.motivoAyuda: It is recorded in the audit log. It is required.
acciones.confirmar_ENVIAR_A_APROBACION: Once sent for approval it can no longer be edited until someone rules on it. Continue?
acciones.confirmar_APROBAR: Approve this sale announcement? It will be ready to publish.
acciones.confirmar_PUBLICAR: Once published it becomes visible to participants as soon as its publication date arrives. Continue?
acciones.confirmar_CONCLUIR: Closing is final: unsold vehicles return to the catalog and there is no way back. Continue?

adjudicacion.filaVacia: No one is queued for this lot.
adjudicacion.sinCupo: No quota left: awarding will fail.

aprobaciones.sinPendientes: There are no sale announcements awaiting a decision.
